title: Studio still offers field externalId as an upsert key after it was graded dead
body:
立卡门:① product defect (user-visible, named landing)

**What is wrong.** Studio still tells a person designing a field that `externalId` drives upserts. #26598 (Part of #25753) graded `field.externalId` `dead` in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, because no upsert, import or seed reads it, and reworded its `.describe()` to say so. Two Studio surfaces still present it as a working upsert key:

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts:392` gives the help text "Mark as external ID for upsert operations". Its generated translations repeat it: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, key `externalId`.
- The designer field form offers the same toggle: `ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/FieldDesigner.tsx:476`, edited and round-tripped by `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`, and the app-shell `ObjectFieldInspector`.

**reach:** the Studio field form, a public UI entry, shows the false help text on every field. A designer who switches it on for an import key gets no upsert matching on that field, and `os lint` then warns on the same flag the form offered.

**Business rationale.** Who benefits: anyone importing or seeding records into an app built in Studio. Scenario: they mark a field "External ID" so a re-import updates rows instead of duplicating them. Cost of not fixing: the flag does nothing, so re-imports silently create duplicates, and the product contradicts its own lint.

**Who acts.** A `ui/` lane PR. Per the protocol-first rule, either stop offering the toggle in the field form and inspector (the protocol keeps parsing the key), or keep it with help text that points to the seed dataset's `externalId` and the import mapping's `upsertKey`. Then re-run the metadata-forms translation pipeline for every locale.

**Duplicate search.** `externalId help text Studio field form upsert` in objectstack-ai/objectstack found 1 hit (#3257, closed, unrelated: field designer metadata-driven). No duplicate.
